issue.title: Task-line ⛓ open/total dependency mini-badge

task_type_fields.proposal:
Add a compact task-line mini-badge (e.g. `⛓ 1/2` = open/total prerequisites) to the dependent task's own line, so a collapsed or scrolled task shows its dependency state without the Depends-On line being visible. It would reuse bob-ledger-tools' dependency chip model (`dependencyChipModel`, the Tasks-memo lookup) shipped by epic bob-cli-3n and follow the same fixed-height inline-widget rules as the freshness mark (`.bob-fresh-mark`), with a toggle like "Toggle dependency chips".

Proposed by bob-cli-3n.11 (publish phase, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #3); the epic plan lists the task-line mini-badge under "Deliberately not doing" (deferred display).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-3n's approved plan explicitly deferred the task-line mini-badge as a display enhancement; the epic's chips render only on the Depends-On line itself. It is new UI, not a gap in the shipped contract.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-3n.11 proposed the task-line mini-badge that the epic plan deferred as a display enhancement; recording it for triage.
